findings.title: Missing `// @vitest-environment node` pragma called for by Implementation step 2
findings.detail: The spec explicitly asks for this pragma, but adding it makes the suite fail (`window is not defined` at src/test/setup.ts:41, a global setupFile outside this unit's target_files), so the omission is justified by the codebase; still worth flagging back to the spec since the literal instruction is unachievable within scope.
